I’ve been to 3 doctor surgeries in my lifetime and this is by far the worst one. If there are any app developers reading this please develop an app where chronically outpatient can rank their experiences at GP surgeries to help other chronically ill people not waste countless years trying to get results from Dr. Obvious suggesting paracetamol to somebody with a chronic pain condition that they had to Google.
